_doc: Frozen reference scores for index_codebase against the small-python fixture. The TS adapter must reproduce these counts byte-identically (no tolerance) — the same Rust binary serves both, so any divergence is an adapter bug. Captured by running the Rust binary directly via the parity test (packages/codebase/__tests__/parity/index_codebase.parity.test.ts).
_note: The Rust binary computes total_elapsed_ms server-side; TS only forwards. Tested in parity test 'Lamport: analyzeCodebase total_elapsed_ms is provided by Rust, not computed by TS' which freezes Date.now() and asserts the result is > 0.
